title: Alex Hartland
text:
I am a political scientist working on digital politics and political attitudes in Europe.
I am currently a postdoctoral researcher (Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter) at the Chair of Political Science and International Relations, University of Saarland.
I study how new technology and political communication shape political attitudes and behaviour, particularly with regard to democratic support and radicalisation.
My research examines the role of digital technologies, including AI and social media platforms, in party competition, attitude change, and electoral behaviour.
I combine computational text analysis and natural language processing with digital trace data, surveys, and experimental and quasi-experimental research designs.

title: Research
text:
I study how new technology and political communication influence public attitudes and behaviour. I use quantitative text analysis and experimental and quasi-experimental research designs to address empirical research questions and inform scholarly and policy debates.
I am also interested in research questions related to democratic support and radicalisation, migration, and political competition among parties and interest groups, working mainly in a European context.
